requirements.text: A subject gets the same variant for an experiment on every visit and device that shares its id
Variant weights are honored, and a zero-weight variant is never assigned
Assignments in different experiments are independent (hashing is salted by the experiment)
An exposure event is recorded once per subject when the variant is actually shown
A subject keeps its variant when an anonymous visitor signs in
Changing traffic allocation does not silently reassign subjects already in the experiment
Conversion metrics are attributed per variant with a statistical significance check
